If you want to use this resourcepack you have to use [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)/[OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui)/[cit resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

🔹 **How to Use:**
This resource pack requires one of the following:
- [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)
- [OptiGUI](https://modrinth.com/mod/optigui)
- [CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

Rename the **Trident** item to **Voltentacle** to activate the custom model.
